headline: China calls for AI cooperation with the US ahead of APEC
body: A quiet Sunday. China called for AI cooperation with the US ahead of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, lifting Global Coordination by 0.22. The US disrupted North Korea's 'FaceStealer' deepfake-call scheme, tied to more than $400 million in crypto theft, nudging Catastrophic Risk up. OpenAI credited GPT-6 Astra with a proof step toward a lattice definition of the Standard Model. Gatekeeper and 1984 rose slightly. Horizon Balance slipped to -10.86 from -10.82.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.1, from China's cooperation call (+0.17) and Astra's physics proof step (+0.02), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.07). 1984 +0.1, mostly from China's cooperation call (+0.10) and fading earlier news (+0.03). Descendants -0.08, from fading earlier news (-0.11), partly offset by Astra's physics proof step (+0.03).
